key_findings: Intranasal dual HDAC/BRD4 inhibitors SUM52 and SUM35 relieved thermal and mechanical allodynia in SNI mice without locomotor side effects; SUM52 was most effective.
SUM52 normalised spinal HDAC1/BRD4 levels and reduced microglial activation, NF-kB/p38 signalling, iNOS, IL-6 and IL-1beta.
